senses.gloss:
† कुज् कुज्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To steal or rob.
 2. To be crooked (cf. कुञ्च्).

कूज् कूज् (onomatop., from the cry of the cuckoo, cf. κόκκυξ, κόκκυγος; O.H.G. gauch; A.S. gaec), i. 1, Par. (Ātm. see नि), To make any inarticulate sound:
 1. To cry, as a bird, MBh. 3, 9926. To coo, Rām. 2, 52, 2.
 2. To buzz, Ṛt. 6, 34, v. r.
 3. To rustle, Ragh. 2, 12.
 4. To moan, Rām. 3, 32, 33.
 5. To fill with one of these sounds, Rām. 3, 78, 27.
 कूजित, n.
 1. Inarticulate sound, Ragh. 9, 26.
 2. Chirping, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 12.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To rival in chirping, Rām. 3, 79, 24; in singing, 2, 96, 13; in moaning, MBh. 3, 14144.
 --With अभि अभि, To buzz, Rām. 3, 79, 6.
 --With आ आ, To sing, as a bird, Suśr. 2, 503, 13. []
 --With उद् उद्, To utter a monotonous sound, Kathās. 10, 130.
 --With उप उप, To fill with a sound, MBh. 3, 5212.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To chirp, Rām. 3, 7, 4.
 2. To fill with chirping, Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 20.
 --With निस् निस्, To utter inarticulate sounds, Rām. 2, 95, 11.
 --With परि परि, To buzz round about, Sāh. D. 55, 20.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To answer by an inarticulate sound, Rām. 2, 56, 9.
 --With वि वि, To cry, Rām. 3, 76, 7.
कुज कुज, i. e. 3. कु-ज (vb. जन्), m. The planet Mars, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 34.

कूज कूज् + अ, m. Croaking of the bowels, Suśr. 2, 514, 1.
 --Comp.
कूजन कूज् + अन, n. Croaking of the bowels, Suśr. 2, 402, 12.
कूजिन् कूजिन्, i. e. कूज + इन्, adj., f. नी, Subject to croaking of the bowels, Suśr. 2, 428, 13.
